taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-04 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 4201.4 | 5.06 | 5.06
2 | 2238.9 | 4.35 | 9.41
3 | 343.9 | 31.91 | 41.32
4 | 25.0 | 0.99 | 42.31
5 | 10.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as H-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-04
Curve type: Q-type (resistivity sequence ρ1 > ρ2 > ρ3 > ρ4 > ρ5 decreases monotonically with depth — this is diagnostic of a Q-type curve; note that the on-file classification as "H-type" does not match the tabulated resistivity values and should be reviewed)
Aquifer depth: approximately 41.32 m to below 42.31 m (low-resistivity zone of 25.0 Ω·m and 10.9 Ω·m, consistent with saturated/conductive material)
Recommendation: Plan drilling to at least 45–50 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity zone beginning at ~41.3 m depth, and collect lithologic samples/resistivity logs across this interval to confirm aquifer presence and verify the curve-type discrepancy noted above.
